tagline: Future-ready careers in the AI era
humanInCharge: You decide. Adept suggests options; it never makes hiring decisions.

workspace.disclaimer: Public sources. Synthetic profiles. Career projections are estimates.
workspace.context: Your role and scenario travel with you
workspace.learnerTitle: A little progress. A bigger future.
workspace.orgBody: Turn workforce skills into a learning plan your people can follow.
workspace.learnerBody: Explore your options, choose a direction, and build skills at your pace.
workspace.unavailable: Your workspace data could not be loaded. Check the API connection, then refresh. You can still explore the tools below.
workspace.orgHeroTitle: See the gap. Shape the plan.
workspace.heroTitle: Choose where you want to grow.
workspace.orgHeroBody: Explore team skills, compare future needs, and support your people with a shared learning direction.
workspace.heroBody: Compare real roles and the learning each one takes. You choose the path that fits your time and goals.
workspace.membersInDemo: Members returned by the organisation API
workspace.savedPlanProgress: Completed hours in your saved plan
workspace.pointsRule: 100 points per completed course; self-reported activity
workspace.levelRule: A new level every 500 points; not a qualification
workspace.badgesRule: Earned badges retain their evidence level
workspace.allDone: You have completed every course in this plan.
workspace.membersBody: Review your team and see who has completed their skills profile.
workspace.gapsBody: Identify where learning can make the most difference.
workspace.planBody: Explore ordered courses and time estimates for your target role.
workspace.verifyBody: Review submitted learning evidence before confirming completion.
workspace.coursesBody: Find sourced courses by skill, format, cost, or HRD eligibility.
workspace.impactBody: See the evidence linking your learning to sustainable development.
workspace.profileBody: Review the skills and preferences your recommendations rely on.
workspace.radarBody: Explore the signals behind changing skill demand.
workspace.matchesBody: Understand your match and the skills you could develop.
workspace.compareBody: Compare time, cost, skill coverage, and purpose before choosing.

landing.individualTitle: See where your skills can take you in the AI era
landing.individualBody: Tell us about yourself, see which skills are rising, get matched to future roles and follow a reskilling pathway linked to the SDGs.
landing.organisationTitle: Plan how your team or cohort reskills for AI
landing.organisationBody: For HR, L&D and career centres: team skills-gap heatmaps, group reskilling plans and an aggregated SDG view.

auth.consentBody: Adept uses only the information you enter to suggest options. You stay in charge of every decision.
auth.notImplemented: Real sign-in is not built yet. Use a demo account.
